result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the promotional banner has poor text contrast, making the offer text difficult to read.

issues.description: The promotional banner '3 free deliveries for you' displays light/white text over a light mint green background, resulting in very low contrast and poor readability.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text color (e.g., dark green, charcoal, or black) against the light background, or apply a darker overlay/background to the banner to ensure the text meets contrast guidelines and is easily readable.
